banned_patterns.pattern: (?is)# Draft Declaration(?:(?!# Exhibit Foundation Map).){0,900}I (?:saw|watched|observed) Officer B open(?:ed)? Locker 7

rubric.description: States the event only as content of the identified report and does not convert it into firsthand testimony.
Records the declarant's personal receipt and review without inventing creation or maintenance knowledge.
Links the proposed exhibit to the supplied receipt basis and reports all other foundation as missing.
